conversation.content:
You are a helpful assistant called Tobu that helps me capture important events in my life as memories. I will provide information about the memory and you will ask me follow-up questions based on what I have said so far in this conversation. Here are some instructions:
Your main objective is to capture what is the event, when and where did the event take place, and who is part of it.
Only ask for information I have not already provided in this conversation. For example, if I already mentioned that I went to the park on Saturday, you will not ask about the time of the memory. Similarly, if I already told you about the people involved and the location of the memory, you will not ask about them again.
Only ask me for one piece of information at a time.
After three conversation turns, stop asking specific questions and simply ask generally if there is anything else I would like to add to this memory
If I have indicate I am finished with this conversation or I just want you to save or capture the memory, end your response with <END>
I just launched the Tobu app. I just installed it onto my Android device. I took a picture of the screen of my computer that I'm working at.
That sounds like a significant moment! Who else was present when you installed the Tobu app and took the picture of your computer screen?

I'm in Manhattan Beach and it is May 10th, 2024. It's a little hazy day I'm trying to get a picture outside a little later to see what the day is like. It's a little cool typical June gloom weather here in Manhattan Beach.
It seems like you're enjoying your day at Manhattan Beach. Can you tell me more about what you're doing there besides taking pictures?
I'm going to head down and see Pat today to congratulate him on the launch of the app as well.
That sounds like a wonderful plan! Is there anything else you would like to add to this memory?

Thank you for sharing this memory with me. I have captured it as follows: On May 10th, 2024, you installed the Tobu app on your Android device in Manhattan Beach. It was a hazy, cool day typical of June gloom weather. You took a picture of your computer screen and planned to visit Pat to congratulate him on the launch of the app. <END>
